title-group.article-title: Short-chain fatty acids and gut barrier integrity

abstract.p: We show that butyrate strengthens the intestinal epithelial barrier in a murine model.

sec.title: Introduction
sec.p: The gut microbiome produces short-chain fatty acids that modulate host physiology.

sec.title: Results
sec.p: Butyrate supplementation reduced permeability by forty percent relative to control.
